critical_code_review_comments: RustRecord.model_validator fills ai_grid_boxes = list(grid_boxes) only when ai_grid_boxes is None at construction. This means a legacy record whose grid was manually edited BEFORE the migration will have its (edited) grid_boxes frozen as ai_grid_boxes — not the true original AI output. The rust_update endpoint mitigates this by freezing ai_grid_boxes during the first PUT after migration, but only if ai_grid_boxes was still None in Mongo at that moment. Since the model_validator runs on every find_one -> RustRecord(**doc) conversion, the first GET will materialize ai_grid_boxes without writing back, and a subsequent PUT will perceive doc.ai_grid_boxes as still None (Mongo not updated) and freeze from the current (possibly edited) grid_boxes. The user's record 767e5224 (never edited) is safe; records that were edited pre-migration may show inaccurate 'AI original' values. Recommendation: run a one-time migration script that writes ai_grid_boxes/ai_rusted_box_count/ai_grade to Mongo for all legacy records at startup.
